title: 5.12 Numbers 30 to 100
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Recognize, hear and say thirty to one hundred, tell thirty from thirteen, and use the numbers in prices and ages.
grammar_function: What number is it? It is number + ten; What is the price? The price is + ten + dollars; He/She is + ten + years old.
prerequisite: 2.6-2.7 What number is it?; 3.5-3.6 thirteen to twenty and years old; 5.8 dollars; 5.11 price.
speaking_outcome: Say thirty to one hundred and say a price with them.
